title: @akoskm/create-mcp-server-stdio command injection via exec in which-app-on-port tool (CVE-2025-54994)
summary: The MCP server scaffold @akoskm/create-mcp-server-stdio before 0.0.13 exposes a `which-app-on-port` tool that concatenates untrusted input into Node.js `child_process.exec`, allowing command injection and remote code execution under the server process's privileges.
